Job Description
 We are looking for a Python Software Engineer to help build and improve the software, workflows and tooling used by Product Security Engineering.
The work may include product and workflow implementation, integrations, automation, developer tooling, tests, CI/CD improvements, operational instrumentation, defect fixes and maintainability improvements across SDLC, application vulnerability management (AppVM) and related AppSec products.
 Main Responsibilities:
 Translate prioritised requirements and acceptance criteria into implementation tasks, estimate assigned work, and deliver changes within the agreed technical direction. Raise design questions, dependencies and risks early, and communicate progress with the internal sponsor and partner teams. 
 Build, test and maintain AI-enabled AppSec integrations and workflow automation, including capabilities that support vulnerability-ticket triage and interactions across Jira, Slack and related security systems. 
 Integrate LLM-powered components into existing services using relevant ticket, repository, scan or knowledge-base context. Validate structured model outputs and route only explicitly permitted actions through application logic, with appropriate input and output validation, access controls, audit records, error handling and human-review paths for uncertain or failed outcomes. 
 Use approved AI-assisted development tools to generate, explain, refactor and test code. Apply software-engineering judgement to verify and adapt generated code for functional behaviour, edge cases, correctness, security, maintainability and alignment with the existing system; write or modify code directly where needed to validate, correct or complete a solution. 
 Contribute to assigned initiatives such as AI-assisted security code review, vulnerability-fix verification and scanning workflows for AI models, MCP servers or skills. Work will follow the agreed backlog and may involve existing services, pilots or evaluation work. 
 Create and maintain automated tests and evaluation cases for agreed functional criteria, edge cases, incomplete or incorrect model responses, and safe failure handling. Help assess quality using relevant measures such as confirmed findings, false positives, coverage, processing time and reliability; participate in code review, address feedback, and diagnose and fix defects. 
 Contribute to CI/CD, operational instrumentation and reliability improvements. Follow secure development practices and company standards for data security, integrity and quality. 
 Document implementation choices and operational context, prepare runbooks or release notes where needed, and hand over work so internal owners can support it. 
 Day-to-day Engineering Skills
 Turn requirements into small, testable changes. Break an acceptance criterion into implementation tasks, identify edge cases and dependencies, estimate the work, and raise design questions or delivery risks early. 
 Build and maintain APIs and integrations. Work with server-side code, APIs, data storage, and external or internal systems; make integrations resilient to missing, late, duplicate, or malformed data. The role specifically calls out APIs, integrations, data storage, and system design. 
 Automate security workflows. Implement or improve flows such as scan-result handling, vulnerability-ticket creation, fix validation, and retesting. 
 Job Requirements
 3+ years of professional software-engineering experience delivering production software, with strong practical experience in one or more server-side programming languages. 
 Ability to work with Python or another relevant language and adapt to the team's stack. 
 Experience translating user or business requirements into tested software changes, and checking that implementations meet functional criteria. 
 Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, data storage and software system design; ability to understand how services exchange data with tools such as Jira, Slack and GitLab. 
 Experience with automated testing, code review, version control and CI/CD practices. 
 Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively while critically assessing generated code for incorrect assumptions, edge cases, correctness, security and maintainability. 
 Understanding of secure coding fundamentals and a careful approach to protecting permissions, sensitive data and production systems, including auditability, failure handling and escalation to a human reviewer. 
 Ability to work independently on team-scoped tasks, make sound implementation decisions, and seek input for unusual or higher-impact situations. 
 Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical choices, surfacing risks and dependencies early, collaborating with others, and documenting and sharing knowledge. 
 Useful additional experience:
 Building internal developer tooling, security products, workflow automation or vulnerability-management capabilities. 
 Working with cloud platforms, containers or distributed services. 
 Improving monitoring, operational readiness or service maintainability. 
 Working in security engineering, application security or software delivery environments. 
 This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification and is not intended to be a comprehensive inventory of all duties and responsibilities. Additionally, the responsibility to possess the necessary employment documents for this country rests with the candidate.
